title: 第十三章 探望九儿的女人第十四章 虚荣心得到满足
content_zh:
秦九儿一个朋友还真的随手就把袋子扔到了地上，“先扔在这儿，待会儿清洁工来了，让她把这个和垃圾一块扫走就可以了。”
正在这时候，门口一动，进来了一个人。
“九儿，都是我的错，你怎么样啊？严重不严重？”
进来的正是王雷，王雷也受了伤，手腕上缠着纱布。
“没多大的事，就是脑袋流了点血，也检查过了没有脑震荡，住院休息两天就可以了。”见到王雷，秦九儿冷冷的脸上，绽放出了漂亮的笑容。
“你也受伤了啊，怎么样？会不会很痛啊，都是我不好，你骑摩托要是不载着我，也不会出这种事。”
接着，秦九儿很关切的对王雷嘘寒问暖的。
说真的，看到这一幕，张辉他们心里都很不爽。
甚至何敏也觉得秦九儿实在有些过分了。
陆原来看望秦九儿，虽然带的东西不怎么好，但是毕竟来探望了，秦九儿对陆原却冷冰冰的。
反之，秦九儿的伤，可以说责任都在王雷的身上，但是秦九儿却对王雷这么暖这么好。
甚至，秦九儿主动把责任揽到了自己的身上。
要知道，当时在百盛园吃完饭，众人出来之后，是王雷主动邀请秦九儿坐他的鬼火摩托车，说要带秦九儿吹风耍的。
不过，怎么说，王雷都挽救了秦九儿一家，众人也只能无可厚非。
“那九儿你多多休息，好好养伤，我们回去了。”
陈锋知道，陆原再留下来，只能越来越郁闷，而且陆原张辉宋纯他们管理学院下午还有课。
众人就离开了医院。
就在他们刚离开不久，一个女人风风火火就闯进了病房。
“九儿，怎么回事，我听说你出车祸了？！”
这女人，二十多岁，穿着一件浅黄色短裙，高跟凉鞋，带着耳环，长相明媚，浑身散发出一种优质白领的气息。

“小姨！”
如果不是头上有伤，秦九儿几乎就一头扎到女人的怀里了。
来的女人，正是秦九儿的小姨凌蓝。
凌蓝虽然是秦九儿的小姨，但是只比秦九儿大三岁，可以说是同龄人也不过分，两人的关系不像是长辈晚辈，更像是闺蜜，凌蓝不像是小姨，更像是姐姐。
摩托车出了事之后，秦九儿自然是不敢跟父母说的，只好给凌蓝打了电话。
“小姨，问题不大，医生说就是破了点皮，早知道这么轻，我就不劳烦你跑来一趟啦！”秦九儿说道。
凌蓝紧张的表情，总算放松了一点。
又看了看王雷手臂上的伤，皱了皱眉。
“我说，九儿的伤是不是和你有关啊，我听说是你骑着摩托车带着九儿出事的，明知道带着女孩子，开车还开的那么快，真没有一点责任心，这一次幸好没出什么大事，要是出了大事，你付得起责任吗你！”
凌蓝心疼秦九儿，再加上凌蓝毕竟年龄大一点，又工作了，社会阅历丰富，一看王雷这样子，她就觉得不是一个很有担当的男生。
“小姨，你不要说王雷，我家的事情，还是他爸爸帮忙摆平的呢！”秦九儿知道小姨特别能说会道，担心惹的王雷不高兴，所以急忙把王雷的事情，简单告知了凌蓝一遍。
秦九儿家里的事情，凌蓝当然也知道。
当时她也很替姐夫一家着急，也托人找了很多关系，不过自然也是起不到作用的了。
content_en:
One of Qin Jiuer's friends actually threw the bag on the ground casually, "Throw it here first. When the cleaner comes later, just ask her to sweep this away with the garbage."
At this moment, the door moved and someone came in.
"Jiu'er, it's all my fault. How are you? Is it serious?"
It was Wang Lei who came in. Wang Lei was also injured and had gauze wrapped around his wrist.
"It's nothing serious. I just had some bleeding on my head. I've been checked to see if there's a concussion. I just need to stay in the hospital and rest for two days." Seeing Wang Lei, Qin Jiuer's cold face burst into a beautiful smile.
"You're injured too, how about it? Does it hurt a lot? It's all my fault. If you weren't carrying me on the motorcycle, this kind of thing wouldn't have happened."
Then, Qin Jiuer greeted Wang Lei with concern.
To be honest, Zhang Hui and the others felt very unhappy when they saw this scene.
Even He Min felt that Qin Jiuer had gone too far.
Lu Yuan came to visit Qin Jiu'er. Although the things he brought were not very good, he came to visit after all, but Qin Jiu'er was cold to Lu Yuan.
On the contrary, it can be said that the responsibility for Qin Jiu'er's injury lies entirely with Wang Lei, but Qin Jiu'er was so warm and kind to Wang Lei.
Qin Jiuer even took the initiative to take the responsibility on himself.
You know, after everyone came out after dinner in Parkson Garden, Wang Lei took the initiative to invite Qin Jiuer to ride on his Will-o'-the-Wisp motorcycle, saying that he would take Qin Jiuer to have fun.
However, no matter what, Wang Lei saved Qin Jiuer's family, so everyone can only blame him.
"Then Jiu'er, please rest more and recover from your injuries. We are going back."
Chen Feng knew that if Lu Yuan stayed, he would only become more and more depressed. Moreover, Lu Yuan, Zhang Hui, Song Chun and the others had classes in the afternoon at the School of Management.
Everyone left the hospital.
Not long after they left, a woman burst into the ward.
"Jiu'er, what's going on? I heard you were in a car accident?!"
This woman, in her twenties, was wearing a light yellow skirt, high-heeled sandals, and earrings. She had a bright appearance and exuded the aura of a high-quality white-collar worker.
"Auntie!"
If it weren't for the injury on his head, Qin Jiuer would have almost jumped into the woman's arms.
The woman who came was none other than Qin Jiuer's aunt Ling Lan.
Although Ling Lan is Qin Jiu'er's aunt, she is only three years older than Qin Jiu'er. It is not too much to say that they are of the same age. The relationship between the two is not like that of elders and juniors, but more like best friends. Ling Lan is not like an aunt, but more like a sister.
After the motorcycle accident, Qin Jiuer naturally did not dare to tell his parents, so he had to call Ling Lan.
"Auntie, the problem is not big. The doctor said it was just a broken skin. If I had known it was so minor, I wouldn't have bothered you to come over!" Qin Jiuer said.
Ling Lan's tense expression finally relaxed a little.
He looked at the injury on Wang Lei's arm again and frowned.
"I asked, is Jiu'er's injury related to you? I heard that you were riding a motorcycle with Jiu'er and the accident happened. You knew you were driving with a girl and drove so fast. You really have no sense of responsibility. Fortunately, nothing serious happened this time. If something big happened, can you bear the responsibility? You!"
Ling Lan felt sorry for Qin Jiu'er, and after all, Ling Lan was older, working again, and had rich social experience. When she saw Wang Lei like this, she felt that he was not a very responsible boy.
"Auntie, please don't talk about Wang Lei. His father helped to settle my family's affairs!" Qin Jiuer knew that his aunt was very talkative and was worried about upsetting Wang Lei, so he hurriedly informed Ling Lan about Wang Lei's affairs.
Of course Ling Lan also knew about Qin Jiuer's family affairs.
At that time, she was also worried about her brother-in-law's family, and asked people to find many connections, but naturally it didn't work.
